lines.text: The hot sun, the burning sand, the emerald water! Is this the fabled beach everyone's always talking about?
It would be even better if I could take a dip in the ocean.
Cheers to the look in your eyes!
Drinking a nice, refreshing soda with you while taking in the ocean view... it doesn't get any better than this.
Yeesh, this swimsuit is pretty skimpy... Hey, get your mind out of the gutter!
Hey, watch where you're touching!
Commander, the ice is going to melt! Nobody likes warm soda...
If you don't get your butt over here, I'm gonna start drinking without you.
Wanna go check out the sea again, just the two of us?
What if we created our own ocean inside the Outpost?
Shower in the sea♪ Shower in the sea♪ Shower in the sea♪
Behold, Anis in a swimsuit! Feast your eyes, gentlemen!
Summertime Anis has leveled up!
The more skimpy my clothing, the more powerful I am... Swimsuits rock!
Is there an upgrade that enables you to swim?
Wow, thanks! That's so nice of you, Commander.
Thanks! I'll put this to good use.
No take-backs, okay?
You drive me up the wall, but somehow I still end up liking you.
Commander, if you keep coming on to me, one of these days I'm going to call your bluff.
Is it hot in here, or is it just me? Hehe...
Are you putting us to work even during our vacation? *Sigh*
I'm here!
Okay, let's go!
I can't believe we even have these guys here!
You're about to get soaked!
Don't the Raptures ever take a vacation?
Time to give you a taste of my water gun.
Can't I just connect this thing to a water tank and be done with it?
Refilling the water!
Refilling underground water!
I can hear the sea calling out!
Let's make some waves!
Hope the water isn't too salty for ya!
You're nothing.
Nice!
Another one down.
Hey!
Damn!
Ouch!
I'll leave the rest to you.
Can we finally hit the beach and relax?
